theories.claim: QA IsolationProven omits ProcessGroup, allowing evidence production without process-group isolation proven
theories.basis: docs/architecture.md:232-234 requires platforms that cannot prove protected-root denial, process-group cleanup, and workspace removal to block before writable work; internal/platform/process/isolation.go:38-45 defines IsolationCapabilities with separate ProcessGroup and DescendantCleanup booleans; internal/sprint/qa.go:463 computes IsolationProven as NativeProtectedRootDeny && DescendantCleanup && WorkspaceRemoval with no ProcessGroup term, so a host with ProcessGroup=false but DescendantCleanup=true passes admission
theories.verification_surface: docs/architecture.md:227-234, internal/platform/process/isolation.go:38-45, internal/sprint/qa.go:449-468 (buildQAEvidencePublication admission construction and ValidateQAAdmission call)
theories.confirmation_condition: File content shows IsolationCapabilities defines ProcessGroup but QA admission logic at internal/sprint/qa.go:463 does not include it, and no other assigned file compensates
theories.refutation_condition: Another assigned file checks ProcessGroup before writable work or proves admission includes it via indirection
theories.inconclusive_condition: ProcessGroup is intentionally excluded from the isolation guarantee or is proven elsewhere outside assigned paths
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only file inspection of assigned paths; grep for ProcessGroup and IsolationProven; compare to docs architecture requirement

theories.outcome_reason: Static inspection confirms mismatch: capability exists but is not gated. Lines internal/sprint/qa.go:463 and internal/platform/process/isolation.go:41 and docs/architecture.md:232-234 together demonstrate violation without needing execution.

theories.claim: Writable QA checks can execute in IsolationWorkspace.Run without native protected-root denial when capability is false
theories.basis: internal/platform/process/isolation.go:158-183 shows Workspace.Run conditionally calls nativeIsolationRequest only if Capabilities.NativeProtectedRootDeny is true, otherwise delegates directly to runner.Run with no read-only root mount; admission gating in internal/sprint/qa.go:463 is single-point and also incomplete (missing ProcessGroup), so isolation guarantee between internal/sprint and internal/platform/process depends entirely on correct admission evaluation and cannot fail-closed at the execution boundary
theories.confirmation_condition: Inspection shows Run does not error when NativeProtectedRootDeny is false and relies solely on prior admission flag; no fail-closed enforcement at process boundary in assigned paths
theories.refutation_condition: Run fails closed when NativeProtectedRootDeny is false, or every writable entry point is proven to call ValidateQAAdmission before any workspace creation
theories.inconclusive_condition: Native isolation enforcement is proven inside nativeIsolationRequest or runner implementation outside assigned paths, or admission is always called on every writable path
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read assigned isolation.go Run method and qa.go admission; request additional process isolation files to verify native implementation and fail-closed behavior

theories.claim: Descendant cleanup and workspace removal are advertised as capabilities but not proven per-investigation via observed cleanup before QA evidence promotion
theories.basis: internal/platform/process/isolation.go:66-70 and 242-262 define CleanupResult with Complete flag and WorkspaceRemoval capability; internal/sprint/qa.go:449-593 builds evidence publication, creates workspaceParent via os.MkdirTemp, loops over shards calling RunQAInvestigation and collects QAEvidenceRecord, but assigned files show no per-record inspection of CleanupResult.Complete or descendant process-group termination before AdjudicateQA/Publish; docs/architecture.md:232-234 requires platforms that cannot prove process-group/descendant cleanup and workspace removal to block before writable work and to report proven containment and cleanup
theories.verification_surface: internal/platform/process/isolation.go:38-45,66-70,242-262, internal/sprint/qa.go:478-594 (workspaceParent handling, RunQAInvestigation loop, adjudication), docs/architecture.md:227-242
theories.confirmation_condition: Full flow shows evidence records and adjudication are published without verifying CleanupResult.Complete and without verifying process-group/descendant cleanup succeeded for each disposable copy
theories.refutation_condition: Assigned or requested files show each RunQAInvestigation verifies cleanup success and aborts/block publication on failure, and qa.go gates on ProcessGroup && DescendantCleanup && WorkspaceRemoval
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cleanup verification exists in non-assigned files (qa_investigation.go, qa_evidence.go) not inspectable under current assignment
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only inspection of assigned paths for CleanupResult usage; request bounded context expansion for qa_investigation.go and qa_evidence.go to verify per-attempt cleanup proof and ValidateQAAdmission implementation
